statement: A RAP production snapshot is modeled biomass. It is not available forage, not carrying capacity, and not a stocking rate. Do not convert the number into a herd size or a ready-for-cattle claim.
source_title: RAP is not stocking advice (CPER trial card)
source_publisher: RangeMatch trial card — not an official knowledge base
review_basis: Provisional CPER test only; interpretation limit, no formula.
